schema: hof-rs / evidence index for the round-1 PRD-coverage batch
what_this_is: For every headline number in .spec/bevy/WRITE-ACCOUNTING-REPORT.md, .spec/bevy/LIVE-COST-REPORT.md, .spec/bevy/ROUND-4-REPORT-COMPLETE.md and .spec/bevy/COVERAGE-EVIDENCE-REPORT.md: the committed files that reproduce it and the command that does it. Every path here is tracked, so a clone can re-derive the numbers without runs/**.

groups.what: the four recorded Developer trajectories the cost analysis reads, byte-identical to runs/<run>/iter-<n>/traj/developer.attempt1.json
the workspace-side battery evidence (.hoh/deterministic/**): one record per step, the verbatim payload behind each criterion, and mcp-errors.jsonl
the round's own evidence directory (runs/bevy-round4/**): 57 raw MCP->BRP call files, the readings, the gate, the launch facts and the launch ledger
iteration 1's result.json and the Tester's evidence.json
iteration 2's result.json and the Tester's evidence.json
iteration 3's result.json and the Tester's evidence.json
the round's own meta.json (model identity, spec hash, engine record, artifact gate)

source_locations_not_committed: F:/moonbit-hof-rs/runs/** (gitignored; 11,229 files / 12,775,066,006 bytes / 11.898 GiB on this disk)

tools.what: the copier that produced this corpus; it key-scans every destination with the repository's own shape rule before writing it
a transcription of src/runtime/secrets.rs's key-shape rule, used to refuse a key-shaped file; it fingerprints findings and never prints a value

key_scan.result: every one of the 118 committed files is CLEAN; no key-shaped token and no key-shaped assignment

headlines.meaning: the four Developer trajectories this project's cost analysis reads, in bytes
the live Developer call's total tokens (150 calls; 3,537,843 prompt + 113,277 completion)

headlines.corrects: defect D-1 of .spec/bevy/ACCEPTANCE-ACCOUNTING.md: the older reports' 'K >= 43 to cut nothing recorded' is round-4 iteration 3's directive window only

headlines.meaning: the frozen PRD's surfaces, with the stable ids that are the coverage denominator
the recorded round-4 battery evidence scored against the frozen registry; Q-startup and B2.1 are gaps because the round predates the e3_process_liveness step
what a round that runs the ten-step battery scores; the four unobservable items are C5, C6, Q-scale, Q-not-required and are named gaps, not missing claims

headlines.note: eleven records: the two gate steps plus the nine E3 steps the round predates the tenth (e3_process_liveness) by

headlines.meaning: the raw MCP->BRP exchanges behind every E3 observation, one JSON-RPC request per file
the self-referential figure the new registry replaces; kept so a reader can see both

not_reproducible_from_the_repository.conclusion: the provider's own per-call usage for any call NOT in the four committed trajectories, and every cost figure in .spec/bevy/LIVE-COST-REPORT.md, COST-REPORT.md, FIX-REPORT.md and ROUND-4-REPORT-COMPLETE.md that rests on them
not_reproducible_from_the_repository.why: the 4,166,273 committed bytes are the four Developer trajectories; every other trajectory (the other three roles, rounds 1-3, the five round-4 attempts) stays under the gitignored runs/**

not_reproducible_from_the_repository.conclusion: byte-level identity of what a successful shell write put on disk
not_reproducible_from_the_repository.why: the recording proves a write ran and reported success; no committed file holds the file's bytes before and after

not_reproducible_from_the_repository.conclusion: the withdrawn step budget's behaviour on a game process, and whether a tree-fingerprint signal reaches the cost target
not_reproducible_from_the_repository.why: both need a live round; no offline replay may execute the recorded shell commands, and this batch ran none

not_reproducible_from_the_repository.conclusion: the seven script-driven edits of round-4 iteration 3 as file contents
not_reproducible_from_the_repository.why: the recordings carry the scripts' text and the commands that ran them, and the accounting reads them; the files they wrote are not in the repository

not_reproducible_from_the_repository.conclusion: the .hoh/deterministic evidence of the five round-4 attempts other than the final one
not_reproducible_from_the_repository.why: the workspace at F:/hof-bevy-r4-run/workspace was overwritten by each pass; only the last pass's tree survives, and only it is committed
